Lauren & Levi 


Lauren and Levi are a delightful and fun couple. I could tell from the moment they reached out that their wedding was going to be special. Nothing makes me happier than couples planning their wedding, their way. Lauren and Levi ooze style, along with being the most photogenic couple ever!

Rupert on Rupert was a fabulous Melbourne wedding venue, it’s one of my favourite venues to document weddings in. Lauren and Levi said their vows under a fabulous floral arrangement that add to the drama of the gorgeous ceremony.

Lauren and Levi opted for a wedding day based on the fact that they wanted their wedding to be one hell of a party, and that’s just what it was! RnB music super loud with everyone on the dance floor belting out their sexiest moves!
